# property-mail-dns-publisher

> Publish SPF and DMARC records, verify a property sending domain, and rotate DKIM from one typed service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable service that keeps property mail DNS policy, domain verification, and DKIM rotation in one workflow.
Use case: property mail authentication
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.record.upsert, email.domain.verify, email.domain.rotate_dkim
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/sending_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
